title: My Morning
text:
My name is Ali. I am a student. I get up at seven o'clock every morning. I eat bread and drink tea for breakfast.

After breakfast, I walk to school. My school is near my house. I like my school because my friends are there. I study English in the afternoon.

questions.text: What does Ali drink for breakfast?
How does Ali go to school?
How does Ali probably feel about going to school?
options: He does not want to go

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
the time between noon and evening

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Ben bir öğrenciyim. Her sabah saat yedide kalkarım. Kahvaltıda ekmek yer ve çay içerim.
Kahvaltıdan sonra okula yürürüm. Okulum evimin yakınında. Okulumu seviyorum çünkü arkadaşlarım orada. Öğleden sonra İngilizce çalışırım.
